cases.name: Heaven Lee Carter Bolen
cases.about: She had opened and owned her own daycare taking care of children of all ages. Each child loved her and the parents of those children truly cared for her. Heaven was always helping others and putting their needs before those of her own. She was loved by many in her community. On Christmas she would take time to deliver clothing, blankets, and food to the less fortunate.
